findings.summary:
Wherever typed-dashes runs (Fine typography on, or the rule switched on), a spaced typed em dash is left as typed when the 8 bytes after it end inside a multibyte character: TypedDashesRule::head() hands the cut string to a /u pattern, preg_match fails, and the dash is read as not spaced. So a pair of spaced em dashes round one short word comes out mixed: `She came — alone — at dawn.` → `She came — alone – at dawn.`, `The plan — which — failed.` → `The plan — which – failed.`, `The plan — that — failed.`, fr `Il est venu — seul — à l’aube.` → `— seul –`. The output is stable, so fix-on-save stores it, a second save changes nothing, the audit never lists it and the page shows the mixed pair. With a straight mark in the word (`

a — it's — x

`) the second pass converts it, so it is also an idempotence failure (133 rows of the rig, class “typed em dash left on pass 1”, including 16 under the stored-content options). The same defect class as the 2026-11-06 gate’s F2(b), fixed tonight for the St window (29281e2) but not here. Present since the D817 build (5146042 and cb57d6a give the same), not in origin/main (d6bb835, which has no typed-dashes), so tonight’s push publishes it; e61e45f’s claim “one pass is the whole fix under the preset” does not reach it.

findings.summary:
D876’s block-start exemption only sees a mark with nothing at all before it in its flow, so a block whose text starts with whitespace gets B38’s apostrophe: a newline and indent after `

`, `

  • ` or ``, a newline after `
    `, or ` `. `

    'It was dark.

    'Then,' she said.

    ` → `’It was dark.` … `‘Then,’`; `

    He wrote:
    'It was dark.

    ` → `’It` (without the newline: `‘It`). HTML does not render that whitespace, so the mark visibly opens the paragraph: the case D876 settled (“a `'` at the very start of a block stays an opening quotation mark”) and README promises (line 84: “or at the very start of a paragraph … it stays an opening quotation mark”; the new Known limit: “A `'` at the very start of a block (a paragraph, a list item, a heading, or after a line break) is an opening quotation mark”). It is not a preset rule: it happens at Pro’s default settings on the page pass and in fix-on-save, and in prose-typeset over hand-written HTML. origin/main (d6bb835, no B38) and 0bb7844 give `‘It`, so the push regresses published behaviour. Text mode is right (a newline there reads as a start), and pretty-printed template HTML (`

    'It was …`) is the usual shape for long quoted copy in a Twig template.
